title: Supply bounded persisted execution context to the fixed-pilot Examiner
problem: Production judge receives answer text without the task evidence needed to assess verified reads, deadline counts, connection checks and server time. Existing historical failures must be retained.
expected_behavior: Release 5b56701aa4da95241e8b18ec4b0f2cafe2e0b9da; manifest 7a15e247b2a65f5f645a4aa8d58c86621c866a527f021e7a41c3141340444a93. Deploy only sandy-examiner-full-cycle from observed version 19. Supply bounded server-persisted receipt context to existing independent judging; never treat it as independent provider-effect proof.
change_purpose: SANDY-ENG-0001 failed/review case correction and independently grounded acceptance.
feature_improvement: Retain bounded source metadata and explicit unknown/pending/failed dispositions without exporting raw customer content, identifiers or credentials.
regression_rules: Preserve fixed pilot, model gateway service authentication and token budget; no new credentials or permissions.
Do not overwrite past judgments, expand enrollment or misreport provider effects.
Require CI, exact source readback, component lease and private rollback.
acceptance_criteria: Focused receipt/gateway tests and independent CI pass.
After genuinely applicable release authorization, rerun failed/review cases with independently verified task/provider evidence; preserve successful historical cases.
